Ví dụ giả định: auth 15 ms, profile 60 m: Assume 15 ms authentication, 60 ms profile fetching, 100 ms posts and 10 ms rendering. Profile and posts can run in parallel only if independent after authentication.
Song song giảm wall time, không giảm tổn: Parallelism reduces wall time, not total downstream work. These are fixed illustrative times; end-to-end p99 cannot be obtained by summing or maximizing individual p99s while ignoring distributions and correlations.
Một request mất bao nhiêu round trip?: How many round trips does a request need?
Mô hình giả định DNS cold 30 ms, server: Assume 30 ms cold DNS, 20 ms server processing and no packet loss. TCP plus TLS 1.3 takes two RTTs before HTTP, fresh QUIC one RTT, and connection reuse no new handshake.
Đây là timeline đơn giản, không đo brows: This simplified timeline is not a browser measurement. DNS may need multiple lookups; certificate work, proxies, resumption, transfer size and congestion are omitted. QUIC integrates transport and TLS rather than adding them like TCP plus TLS.
Polling hay server push cho bảng tỉ số?: Polling or server push for a scoreboard?
Giả định một update mỗi 30 giây, snapsho: Assume one update every 30 seconds and 200-byte snapshot/event payloads. Polling returns a snapshot for every request; push sends updates only. Headers, heartbeats, handshakes and reconnections are excluded.
Polling có độ trễ phát hiện trung bình k: Polling detects updates after about half an interval on average if arrivals are uniformly distributed within the cycle. Push needs held connections and backpressure; both SSE and WebSockets retain connection state. Every transport still incurs fan-out costs.
Vì sao latency tăng mạnh gần saturation?: Why does latency rise sharply near saturation?
Mô hình M/M/1 có một server, arrival Poi: The M/M/1 model has one server, Poisson arrivals, exponential service times, a fixed ten-jobs/s service rate and an unbounded queue. It is a teaching model, not a production-latency prediction.
Mô hình có steady state; latency gồm ser: The model has a steady state; latency includes service and queue waiting.
Arrival đạt hoặc vượt service rate: khôn: Arrivals meet or exceed the service rate: this model has no finite steady-state queue.
Hệ thật có nhiều worker, burst, tail và: Real systems have multiple workers, bursts, tails and queue caps and require separate measurements. Admission control bounds waiting and protects dependencies; a queue does not turn sustained overload into capacity.
30 request đến cách nhau 40 ms; mỗi node: Thirty requests arrive 40 ms apart; each node has one serial worker and long jobs follow a fixed schedule. Least outstanding counts running and queued jobs. The model excludes connection pooling and network latency.
Node B xử lý chậm gấp đôi: Node B takes twice as long
Các thanh biểu diễn thời gian bắt đầu và: Bars show each job’s start and finish
Số request bằng nhau chưa chắc lượng côn: Equal request counts need not mean equal work. Outstanding-count policies do not know a new job’s duration; better results on one schedule do not prove a policy wins every workload.
400 key giả định được hash vào vòng 32-b: Four hundred sample keys are hashed onto a 32-bit ring. Each node has virtual tokens; a key moves clockwise to its first token. The baseline has three nodes with the same virtual-token count.
Token trên vòng hash và đường tới owner: Ring tokens and the key’s ownership route
Virtual tokens giúp phân phối nhiều key,: Virtual tokens distribute many keys but do not split one hot key’s load. Routing changes do not migrate data; storage needs replication, ownership versions and migration/catch-up. This illustrative hash is not cryptographic.
LRU, LFU và FIFO trên cùng một request t: LRU, LFU and FIFO on the same request trace
Cache giữ tối đa ba key, mọi object có c: The cache holds three equal-size keys. LFU counts from insertion and uses LRU tie-breaking without aging. Results depend on this trace and are not a general policy benchmark.
Changing the policy replays the same trace from the beginning. FIFO keeps insertion order on hits, LRU updates recency, and LFU retains frequently used keys but can preserve obsolete popularity without decay.
100 key đã có trong cache; tại thời điểm: One hundred keys are cached; ten requests read each key simultaneously at the selected time. Default TTL is 60 seconds; jitter spreads expiry from 45 to 75 seconds. This snapshot counts misses then, not lifetime cache load.
Single-flight trong mô hình hợp nhất mis: The model’s single-flight coalesces same-key misses into one origin load while other requests wait. Jitter spreads expiry across keys but does not coalesce a hot key’s misses. Cross-process coordination requires separate design.
B abort và retry toàn transaction: B aborts and retries the whole transaction
B đọc lại thấy 1 bác sĩ; Bob tiếp tục tr: B rereads one doctor; Bob stays on-call
Vi phạm invariant: không còn bác sĩ trực: Invariant violated: no doctors remain on-call
Write skew: hai transaction, hai row: Write skew: two transactions, two rows
Alice và Bob cùng trực. Mỗi transaction: Alice and Bob are on-call. Each transaction counts doctors and takes one off-call when more than one remains. They update different rows, so preventing same-row lost updates does not preserve the invariant.
Mô hình serializable chọn một transactio: The serializable model aborts one transaction and retries with fresh state. It illustrates an interleaving rather than implementing MVCC/SSI or a lock manager; real engines may abort a different transaction.
Memtable flush khi có ba key distinct. S: The memtable flushes at three distinct keys. Immutable SSTs are read newest-first and tombstones prevent resurrection. Compaction merges all SSTs while retaining tombstones; WALs, Bloom filters, levels and snapshot GC are omitted.
† là tombstone; ∅ là không có value tron: † marks a tombstone; ∅ means no value in this model. Change steps to see C=c1 before deletion and C=† afterwards; compaction must not resurrect c1.
Key-count đều chưa chắc traffic đều: Even key counts do not imply even traffic
1.000 key có ID tăng dần. Chọn 90% traff: One thousand keys have increasing IDs. Direct 90% of traffic to the newest hundred keys or one hot key and compare range/hash partitioning. The model covers placement, not migration or transactions.
Hash giúp trải nhiều key mới, nhưng một: Hashing spreads many new keys, but a hot key still has one owner. More shards can improve key counts without fixing that key’s bottleneck.

A là leader term 1. Entry tại index 1 đã: A is the term-1 leader. The entry at index 1 is committed on all five nodes.
Mạng chia A,B khỏi C,D,E. A append x tại: The network separates A,B from C,D,E. A appends x at index 2 on A,B, but two acknowledgements cannot form a majority of three, so x is not committed.
C được C,D,E bỏ phiếu trong term 2. A vẫ: C receives votes from C,D,E in term 2. Until it hears otherwise, A may still believe it leads term 1; A lacks a quorum to commit.
C replicate y tại index 2, term 2 lên C,: C replicates y at index 2, term 2, to C,D,E and commits it. The x entry on A,B remains uncommitted; two different values have not both committed at index 2.
A,B nhận term 2, A step down. Log x chưa: A,B observe term 2 and A steps down. Uncommitted x is replaced by y, and the nodes apply the committed entry. The committed entry at index 1 remains intact.
Đọc sau khi ghi: trả dữ liệu cũ hay chờ?: Read after write: return stale data or wait?
Session từng đọc version 2, rồi ghi thàn: The session previously read version 2, then successfully wrote version 3 on the primary. Choose the replica version. The watermark requires at least version 3; this model stays still until you advance the replica.
Chờ watermark giữ lời hứa bằng cách chưa: Waiting for the watermark preserves the promise by withholding a result; it does not accelerate replication. Production needs a deadline and an explicit fallback policy.
Quorum: giao nhau và khả năng tiếp tục: Quorums: intersection and ability to proceed
Cùng một tập N home replica cố định. Tập: All requests use the same fixed set of N home replicas. The write set starts at the beginning and the read set at the end to show the smallest intersection. Failures only determine whether enough acknowledgements are possible; the sets are not a live request.
Giao nhau không tự giải quyết concurrent: Intersection does not resolve concurrent writes, partial writes, version ordering or sloppy quorums. This result is not a linearizability certificate.
Raft: leader cũ còn sống, quorum quyết đ: Raft: an old leader can remain alive; quorum decides commit
Đây là năm frame chọn trước, không phải: These are five selected frames, not a complete Raft simulator. Assumptions: initially identical logs, fixed membership and crash faults. Timers, disk flushes, snapshots and other interleavings are omitted. Groups represent a partition only in frames 2–4.
Thêm consumer có luôn tăng parallelism?: Does adding consumers always increase parallelism?
Một classic consumer group đọc một topic: One classic consumer group reads one topic. Each partition has one assigned member; the round-robin mapping below is illustrative, not a particular assignor or rebalance protocol.
Đây là giới hạn assignment của classic g: This is a classic-group assignment limit, not a limit on all processing strategies. Per-key concurrency needs correct ordering and commits; share groups have different semantics.
Crash giữa side effect và ACK: Crash between the side effect and acknowledgement
One event increments a database balance. The first delivery crashes at the selected point; an unacknowledged event is redelivered to completion. A dedup receipt protects the effect only when both commit in one transaction.
The event was acknowledged but its effect was lost.
The effect was repeated after redelivery.
Logical event tạo đúng một effect trong: The logical event produced one effect in this scenario.
This model excludes external payment APIs. Effects outside the transaction need sink cooperation or idempotency, plus reconciliation of unknown outcomes.
Commit offset không được vượt khoảng trố: Committed offsets must not skip gaps
Chọn những offset đã xử lý durable. Comm: Select durably completed offsets. The committed offset is the next record to read and may advance only through a contiguous completed prefix. Complete offset 7 before offset 0 to see why max(completed)+1 can skip work.
Hoàn tất ở đây nghĩa là effect và tiến đ: Completion means the required effect and progress are durable under the contract. Rebalances also need stopping/fencing of stale workers; an offset does not replace ownership.
Window là 1.000 ms; mỗi request tốn một: The window is 1,000 ms and every request costs one unit. Token refill uses limit/second; the leaky queue has that service rate and a separate buffer capacity. Rolling windows use (t−1,000, t].
✓ là nhận vào, × là từ chối; leaky queue: ✓ means admitted and × rejected; leaky-queue admission is not immediate execution. The sliding counter approximates arrivals, not a strict rolling limit. This deterministic replay does not benchmark server performance.
Counter báo 5 nhưng có thể đã cho qua hơ: The counter says 5, but more than 5 may have passed
Counter hiện là 4, limit là 5. Các conte: The counter starts at 4 with a limit of 5. In nonatomic mode contenders read the same state before writing. Compare admitted requests against the final stored counter.
Atomic ở đây là một decision không inter: Atomic means one noninterleaved decision over the same keyed state. Replication/failover, cross-shard keys and durable billing quotas remain separate problems.
Chia 63 bit: không có lựa chọn miễn phí: Allocate 63 bits: every choice has a cost
Giữ sign bit bằng 0. Thay worker bits và: The sign bit stays zero. Change worker and sequence bits; timestamp gets the remainder. The example uses relative time 100,000,000 ms, worker 7 and sequence 3, not a production ID.
Các trần này chỉ đến từ bit layout. Cloc: These ceilings come only from the bit layout. Clock rollback, restart state, worker reuse, thread safety and real throughput need separate designs; allocating bits does not achieve theoretical performance.
Time prefix thay đổi vùng leaf được chạm: Time prefixes change the leaf region touched
B-tree leaf model có tối đa bốn key, spl: The B-tree leaf model holds four keys per leaf and splits in the middle on overflow. Random mode uses a fixed permutation; time mode increases by timestamp groups with reverse order inside each. Buffer pools, internal pages, fill factors and real engines are omitted.
Split count đơn lẻ không chứng minh hiệu: Split counts alone do not establish performance: ordered inserts also split. Observe locality and benchmark the real engine; UUIDv7 within one millisecond does not establish global creation order.
Mỗi component có xác suất khả dụng 99,9%: Each modeled component is available with probability 99.9%. The chain needs every component; the redundant group needs one replica. These are separate structures, not the same architecture.
Lỗi chung có xác suất 1% làm mất cả nhóm: A 1% common-cause failure takes down the entire redundant group
Phép nhân chain giả định độc lập. Nhóm r: The chain product assumes independence. Replicas are conditionally independent without the common failure; adding replicas cannot exceed that common-cause availability ceiling. These are illustrative probabilities, not an SLO forecast from marketing figures.
Retry nhân tải; jitter chỉ trải thời điể: Retries multiply load; jitter only spreads timing
Worst case: mỗi layer gọi layer dưới tối: Worst case: each layer tries the downstream up to the selected total attempt count, including the initial call. The separate chart has 24 failing requests, at most three attempts at one layer and 100/200 ms backoff; each bucket spans 50 ms.
Full jitter cho lịch retry minh họa: Full jitter for the illustrative retry schedule
Đổi layers/attempts tác động phép nhân w: Layers/attempts affect the worst-case multiplier; jitter/budget affect the single-layer chart. Jitter does not reduce total attempts, while budgets cap retries. Deadlines, network latency and dependency recovery are omitted.
Circuit breaker: đóng, mở và probe: Circuit breaker: closed, open and probing
Failure liên tiếp đạt threshold thì open: Consecutive failures reaching the threshold open the breaker for five model time units. After cooldown, admit one probe: success closes it and failure reopens it. This sequential state machine omits concurrent requests and late responses.
Trong half-open, hai nút request biểu di: In half-open, request buttons complete the admitted probe rather than create another. Production must bound concurrency, fence stale responses by generation and choose appropriate metrics/windows rather than merely three consecutive failures.
Mã ngắn chứa được bao nhiêu link?: How many links fit in a short code?
Alphabet cố định: 0–9, a–z, A–Z. Đổi chi: The alphabet is fixed: 0–9, a–z, A–Z. Change namespace length, occupied codes and the ID to inspect encoding. Records are measured in millions; the namespace uses exactly L characters, with optional leading-zero padding.
Nhập từ 1 đến 20 chữ số thập phân, không: Enter 1–20 decimal digits without a sign.
ID vừa namespace đang chọn: The ID fits the selected namespace
ID vượt namespace đang chọn: The ID exceeds the selected namespace
Đọc các ký tự dư từ dưới lên. Đây là enc: Read remainder digits from bottom to top. This is encoding, not encryption.
Hai xác suất trả lời hai câu khác nhau:: The probabilities answer different questions: whether the next draw hits an occupied code, and whether at least one pair collides in n raw draws before deduplication. The birthday approximation assumes independent uniform draws with n small relative to the namespace; a large exponent puts the probability near 100%. Conditional insertion is required even at low collision probability; a full namespace cannot hold another same-length code.
Đổi đích rồi, vì sao trình duyệt vẫn tới: Why does the browser still use an old destination after an update?
Một browser bấm cùng link 10 lần ở giây: One browser follows the same link ten times at seconds 0, 10, …, 90. The origin changes the destination from A to B at the selected time. The replay uses explicit response Cache-Control; it does not simulate heuristic freshness or noncompliant caches.
Đổi 301 ↔ 302 với cùng max-age không xóa: Switching 301 ↔ 302 with the same max-age does not clear a cache. no-cache permits storage but requires validation before reuse; the model counts validation requests as origin contacts. no-store prohibits storing new responses. Clearing a CDN cannot erase browser-cached responses; an origin policy change does not recall a still-fresh copy.
